# fskill

> Lean engineering workflows and concise principles for AI coding agents: 9 workflow skills (`/f-mode`, `/think`, `/hunt`, `/check`, `/ui`, `/learn`, `/write`, `/handoff`, `/health`) paired with deterministic scripts and optional `rules/principles.md`. All 9 skills are explicit-only (invoke via `/name`, `$name`, or active `/f-mode`).

Source code: https://github.com/gofenix/fskill
npm package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@gofenix/fskill
Latest release: https://github.com/gofenix/fskill/releases/latest
Author: gofenix, https://github.com/gofenix

fskill combines and adapts material from Waza (https://github.com/tw93/Waza), Matt Pocock skills (https://github.com/mattpocock/skills), and pstack (https://github.com/cursor/plugins/tree/main/pstack). The root LICENSE preserves upstream notices and credits.

## Workflow skills (9)

- `f-mode`: explicit session router (`/f-mode` on/off/status) selecting workflows and applying engineering principles without expanding permissions.
- `think`: pre-implementation planning, value judgments, scope triage, prompt reframing/sharpening, and `grill me` pressure testing.
- `hunt`: root-cause debugging with runtime proof, plus single-hypothesis metric optimization.
- `check`: evidence-backed diff/PR/release review, release readiness judgment, project audit signals, and incident replay.
- `ui`: distinctive, non-slop frontend UI design, motion, and real-render verification.
- `learn`: URL/PDF fetching (`fetch.sh`, Feishu, Weixin) and primary-source research synthesis.
- `write`: Chinese/English prose de-AI polishing, release notes, and localization.
- `handoff`: compact session handoff and live-verified context resume.
- `health`: deterministic agent config, hook/MCP, token-tool, maintainability, and rule-pruning audits.

## Engineering principles (shared rule)

- `rules/principles.md` (mirrored into `skills/f-mode/references/principles.md`): 8 `pstack`-style invariants covering subtraction before adding, premise falsification, root-cause proof, live verification, behavioral tests, explained numbers, structural encoding, and one-way-door boundaries.

## Install

All skills:

`npx skills add gofenix/fskill -a claude-code codex cursor -g -y`

Pi package:

`pi install npm:@gofenix/fskill`

Claude Desktop:

Download `https://github.com/gofenix/fskill/releases/latest/download/fskill.zip` and upload it in Customize > Skills.
